title: `SUBSTR` counts a negative start from the end
verdict: start 0 reads as 1; negative counts from the end; sverify passes starts ≥ 1
description: `SUBSTR('hello', 0, 2)` is `he`, as a start of 1. `SUBSTR('hello', -2)` is `lo`. A negative length is `''`, a start past the end `''`, and `SUBSTR('hello', -9, 3)` `''`. Positions count code points (`SUBSTR('héllo', 2, 2)` is `él`).
reference: `substring` with `negative_start: WRAP_FROM_END`, 1-based characters. sverify's SQL computes a wrapped start itself and passes only starts of at least 1 (`Lowering.substring`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT substr('hello', 0, 2), substr('hello', 1, 2), substr('hello', -2), substr('hello', -2, 1), substr('hello', 2, -1), substr('hello', 2, 0), substr('hello', 9), substr('hello', -9, 3), substr('héllo', 2, 2), substr('hello', 4294967297, 1)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
